title: Short Forms
statement: A note-taking app shortens long words. Given a list of short forms and a sentence of words separated by single spaces, replace each word that starts with some short form by the shortest such short form. Words with no matching short form stay as they are. Return the new sentence.

examples.input: forms = ["cat", "bat", "rat"], sentence = "the cattle was rattled by the battery"
examples.output: "the cat was rat by the bat"

answerKey.pattern: A trie of short forms; walk each word until a form ends or a letter is missing
keyPoints: Insert every short form and mark where each ends
For each word, walk the trie letter by letter
Stop at the first end mark (the shortest form) or keep the word if the path breaks
answerKey.timeComplexity: O(total letters of forms + sentence length)
edgeCases: A form equal to a whole word
Two forms where one is a prefix of the other: the shorter wins
acceptableSlowerApproaches: For each word try every form: O(words · forms · L)
Try every prefix of each word in a hash set: O(sentence length · L), also fine

hints: Which short form should win when several match?
The shortest one: the first end mark you meet while walking the trie.
Insert forms with an end flag; for each word, walk until an end flag or a missing child.

input: the cattle was rattled by the battery
tests.expected: the cat was rat by the bat
